[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/640890/extras/a298416a89cf130f60bdb1f25680db59.poster.avif?t=1759283772" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/640890/extras/a298416a89cf130f60bdb1f25680db59.webm?t=1759283772" width="600" height="336"][/imgvid]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Simple but deep mechanics
    [*]Play vs. another players recordings 
    [*]Beat the Developer 
    [*]Global Highscore
    [*]Lots of Particles and Bullets
[/list]

[h2]Beat the Developer[/h2]
You are able to play against the Developer in Will Glow the Wisp, but only the best players will be able to handle this challenge. Do you want to give it a try?

[h2]Play vs Content Creators (Games Journalist, Youtubers, Streamers…)[/h2]
We love all content creators that is why you can play against recordings of content creators. Content creators get visibility by having a separate Highscore and people are able to get to their linked homepage, driving additional traffic to the content creators.

data.strSnippet: Navigate through psychadelic mazes to chill electornic beats. Imagine a mix between Super Meat Boy and Geometry Wars.
